auto_upgrade.title: Auto Upgrade
auto_upgrade.description:
Whether to automatically upgrade a standalone install of Snowflake CLI within the same major version
https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/snowflake-cli/connecting/configure-cli#enable-automatic-upgrades

auto_upgrade_allow_major.title: Auto Upgrade Allow Major
auto_upgrade_allow_major.description:
Whether automatic upgrades may install the next major version
https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/snowflake-cli/connecting/configure-cli#enable-automatic-upgrades

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description:
The default output format for command results, case-insensitive
https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/snowflake-cli/connecting/configure-cli#set-a-default-output-format

ignore_new_version_warning.title: Ignore New Version Warning
ignore_new_version_warning.description:
Whether to suppress notifications about newer Snowflake CLI versions
https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/snowflake-cli/connecting/configure-cli#suppress-version-update-notifications

air_gapped.title: Air Gapped
air_gapped.description:
Whether Snowflake CLI runs in an air-gapped environment, which disables automatic upgrades
https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/snowflake-cli/connecting/configure-cli#enable-automatic-upgrades

Encoding.title: Encoding
Encoding.description:
Configuration for the encodings used by Snowflake CLI
https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/snowflake-cli/connecting/configure-cli#configure-encoding

file_io.title: File I/O Encoding
file_io.description: The encoding used to read and write project files such as SQL scripts and snowflake.yml

subprocess.title: Subprocess Encoding
subprocess.description: The encoding used to decode output of external processes such as pip or docker

stdout.title: Standard Output Encoding
stdout.description: The encoding used for standard output

enable_separate_authentication_policy_id.title: Enable Separate Authentication Policy ID
enable_separate_authentication_policy_id.description: When this access is enabled, specified users can access Snowflake CLI but not the other Snowflake drivers.

save_logs.title: Save Logs
save_logs.description: Whether to save logs to a file

level.title: Level
level.description: The level of logs to output

path.title: Path
path.description: specifies the absolute path to save the log files. The format of the path varies based on your operating system. If not specified, the command creates a logs directory in the default config.toml file location.

SnowflakeConnection.title: Snowflake Connection Configuration
SnowflakeConnection.description: Configuration settings for connecting to a Snowflake database instance

user.title: Username
user.description: The username to authenticate with Snowflake

password.title: Password
password.description: The password for authentication with Snowflake

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.description: The name of the Snowflake warehouse to use for queries

database.title: Database
database.description: The name of the Snowflake database to connect to

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The name of the database schema to use

role.title: Role
role.description: The name of the Snowflake role to use

authenticator.title: Authenticator
authenticator.description: The name of the Snowflake authenticator to use

private_key_file.title: Private Key File for JWT Authentication
private_key_file.description: The path to the private key file for the Snowflake JWT Authentication

private_key_file_pwd.title: Private Key File Password for JWT Authentication
private_key_file_pwd.description: The password for the private key file for the Snowflake JWT Authentication

private_key_path.title: Private Key Path for Key Pair Authentication
private_key_path.description: The path to the private key file for the Snowflake Key Pair Authentication

private_key_passphrase.title: Private Key Passphrase for Key Pair Authentication
private_key_passphrase.description: The passphrase for the private key file for the Snowflake Key Pair Authentication

token_file_path.title: Token File Path for OAuth
token_file_path.description: The path to the token file for the Snowflake OAuth Authentication

workload_identity_provider.title: Workload Identity Provider
workload_identity_provider.description: The workload identity provider to use for WIF authentication

workload_identity_entra_resource.title: Workload Identity Entra Resource
workload_identity_entra_resource.description: e resource to use for WIF authentication on Azure environment
